what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Uzbekistan in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 14630 Uzbek asylum seekers in the United States, 84.1% of all asylum seekers from Uzbekistan.
Refugees from Uzbekistan, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Germany, Sweden and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uzbekistan with the IMU in 1999 and 2000, and with JIG in 2004.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Uzbekistan in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 134 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 19744, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
